title: 第1章 我不是奴隶第2章 杀人
content_zh:
古江，乃是八古大陆第一奇观。
江水宽达千丈，自大陆中央最高峰天神山汇聚而下，向东南方向，长达数千万里，横切半片大陆。
古江之险，有死无生。江水水流湍急，一泻千里。江水之上狂风怒潮，黑风巨浪。站在古江之滨，仿佛站在地狱之门前，满耳都是鬼哭狼嚎，让人毛骨悚然！
不仅如此，古江两侧尽是悬崖峭壁，最低处也要高达百丈有余，高处更是犹如山崖险峰一般，壁立千仞。站在古江边往下望去，犹如无尽深渊！
事实亦是如此，从远古至今，古江不知道埋没了多少人的尸体。无论是卑微的奴隶，还是举世无双的强者，都被这凶猛的江水吞没。古江之威，无人敢触犯一丝一毫。而落入古江者，也从未听过有人活下来。
八古纪元，一万三千六百二十四年。
就在今夜，古江异常可怕。江水不知怎的，变得异常凶猛起来。狂风四起，巨浪滔天！
古江之上，阴云密布，电闪雷鸣！暴雨倾盆而下，打在碎石之上发出恐怖的声音。一道道黑色闪电从空中直奔古江，天昏地暗，犹如世界末日！
就在古江一侧的悬崖上，一个女人骑着一头浑身燃烧着红色火焰的巨兽正在飞快赶路，而女人的怀里，赫然抱着一个刚刚出生的婴儿！
女人年轻貌美，配得上倾国倾城之名。只不过这美丽的容颜毫无血色，苍白如纸。脸上尽是水滴，让人分不清是雨水还是女人流下的虚汗。怀里的婴儿在暴雨中嚎啕大哭，她只能尽力用身体为婴儿遮挡暴雨，可越是这样，她承受的暴雨越多，身体就越虚弱。
突然，女人的脑海一片空白，身体一晃，竟要从巨兽的身上掉下来！这巨兽马上感觉到，连忙抖动脊背，才将女人稳定下来。
短暂的空白后女人强行恢复一点意识，她的脑袋很晕，晕到已经无法控制。
巨兽回头看了一眼背上虚弱的女人，目眦欲裂，猛地从口中发出一股不甘的嘶吼声，四条腿更加用力拼命朝着前方冲去！凶悍的爪子抓在地上，地面如同钢铁般的石头瞬间被踩得粉碎！
没人比这巨兽更加知道，这个女人到底遭遇了什么。刚刚临盆结束的女人就被从床上拉了起来，带着孩子一路逃亡，直到现在已经在暴雨中狂奔了足足三个时辰，这对于任何女人来说，都是要命的！
如今，这巨兽只恨自己不能像朱雀或者龙族一样在天空飞翔，虽然在陆地上自己的速度是最快的，肉眼看着犹如一条极速蔓延的火焰一般，所过之处会在地面上留下连暴雨都无法扑灭的火团。但在敌人四面八方的围追堵截中，它被迫只能朝着这一个方向赶路。而路的尽头是毫无生还可能的古江，这一点，巨兽也很清楚。
噗……
巨兽突然感觉到背上的女人要倒下，而这一次的幅度很大，根本不可能靠抖动背部来给她扶正，情急之下，巨兽在狂奔的过程中凌空转身，直接将女人搂入自己怀中，跟着背部狠狠撞在地面上！
轰隆隆！
巨大的冲击力在地面上划出一道深深的沟壑，过了好久才终于停下来！待停稳后，巨兽连忙摊开前肢，紧张看着怀中的女人。
只见女人脸色更加苍白，就像被雨水浸透的纸片一样。女人虚弱从巨兽怀中挣扎出来，没有在乎自己，而是连忙低头看向怀中的孩子。

孩子仿佛受了惊吓一般，哭得更加厉害，哭声仿佛与天空中不停落下的闪电融为一体。女人低头看着孩子还活着，下唇微紧，眼泪簌簌往下掉。
那巨兽见到女人和孩子都没事，脸上竟然表现出松了一口气的表情，跟着巨兽竟然站在一边，周身突然发出一阵迷雾，待迷雾散去，竟然变成一个身材高大的红发女子！
“小婷，你感觉怎么样？”红发女子连忙蹲下，看着女人的样子极为着急问道。
女子抬头看了红发女子一眼，勉强露出一抹苍白的笑容，虚弱说道，“我还好，没事。”
女子的声音似水如歌，如空谷幽兰，即便如此落魄依然气质不减，让世间所谓的大家闺秀自惭形秽。
暴雨滂沱，雷电越来越多，古江的惊涛骇浪拍在山崖之上，更是地震山摇。
还不等红发女人说什么，女子再次开口，虚弱说道，“前方就是古江了，我已走投无路，可你不一样。你实力那么强，只要不带着我和孩子就一定可以突出重围。”
“你这是在说什么？！”红发女子听到小婷的话，一脸愤怒，说道，“我在你心里就是这样贪生怕死吗？今天我一定要保你活着，他们想杀你的话就要先从我的尸体上踏过去，我不信他们敢得罪我们火狮族！”
“他们不敢得罪火狮族，但是敢杀你。”女子呢喃软语，轻咳两声，极为虚弱说道，“他们人太多，你势单力薄，一旦他们起了杀心，真的杀你谁又能为你作证？你若因我而死，那我黄泉路上也不会安心。”
“小婷！”红发女子不仅没有听进去，反而更加生气起来，大声说道，“我说了，今天谁也死不了！我马上变回原形，继续赶路！”
“红衣！”见到红发女人竟然要恢复兽形，女子再也忍不住，开口斥责道，“你清醒一点好不好，前面就是古江，我们还能往哪里逃？！”
被称为‘红衣’的红发女人身体一震，呆立在原地。身后一道闪电落下，发出绝望的声音。
“那怎么办，我不能眼睁睁看着你死！”红衣的眼眶一下子就红了，跪在女子身旁，哽咽说道，“我们当初说好的，我还要带你去火狮族游玩……”
“来世吧。”女人莞尔一笑，轻轻说道，“这辈子有你这样的好姐妹，我也死而无憾了。”
红衣听到后，忍不住别过头，眼泪拼命的流。
content_en:
Gujiang is the first wonder of the Bagu Continent.
The river is thousands of feet wide. It converges from the Tianshen Mountain, the highest peak in the center of the continent, and goes southeast for tens of millions of miles, cutting across half of the continent.
The dangers of the ancient river are life and death. The water flow in the river is rapid, and it cascades thousands of miles. Above the river there was a violent storm, black wind and huge waves. Standing on the shore of the ancient river, it feels like standing in front of the gate of hell, filled with howling ghosts and wolves, which is terrifying!
Not only that, there are cliffs on both sides of the ancient river. The lowest point is more than a hundred feet high, and the higher points are like cliffs and dangerous peaks, standing thousands of feet high. Standing on the bank of the ancient river and looking down, it looks like an endless abyss!
This is also true. From ancient times to the present, Gujiang did not know how many bodies he had buried. Whether he was a humble slave or an unparalleled strong man, they were all swallowed up by this ferocious river. No one dares to offend the power of the ancient river. As for those who fell into Gujiang, I have never heard of anyone surviving.
Eight Ancient Era, thirteen thousand six hundred and twenty-four years.
Just tonight, Gujiang was extremely scary. The river water somehow became extremely fierce. There are strong winds and huge waves!
Above the ancient river, there are dark clouds and lightning and thunder! The heavy rain poured down, hitting the gravel and making a terrifying sound. Black lightning shot straight from the sky towards Gujiang. The sky was dark and the earth was dark, like the end of the world!
On the cliff on one side of the ancient river, a woman was riding a giant beast with red flames all over its body and was riding quickly. In the woman's arms, she was holding a newborn baby!
The woman is young and beautiful, worthy of the name of a charming country. It's just that this beautiful face is bloodless and pale as paper. There were water droplets all over her face, and it was hard to tell whether it was rain or the woman's sweat. The baby in her arms was crying loudly in the rainstorm. She could only try her best to shield the baby from the rainstorm with her body. But the more she did this, the more rainstorms she endured, the weaker her body became.
Suddenly, the woman's mind went blank, her body swayed, and she was about to fall off the giant beast! The giant beast felt it immediately and quickly shook its back to stabilize the woman.
After a brief blank period, the woman forcibly regained some consciousness. Her head was so dizzy that she could no longer control it.
The giant beast looked back at the weak woman on its back, its eyes were about to burst, and it suddenly let out an unwilling roar from its mouth, and rushed forward with all its strength on its four legs! The ferocious claws clawed at the ground, and the ground was instantly crushed like steel-like stone!
No one knows better than this giant beast what happened to this woman. The woman who had just given birth was pulled up from the bed and fled with her child. Until now, she had been running wildly in the heavy rain for three hours. This is fatal for any woman!
Now, this giant beast just hates that it can't fly in the sky like Suzaku or the Dragon Clan. Although it is the fastest on land, it looks like a rapidly spreading flame to the naked eye. Wherever it passes, it will leave a fireball on the ground that even heavy rain cannot extinguish. But with enemies chasing and intercepting it from all directions, it was forced to move in only one direction. At the end of the road is Furue, who has no chance of survival. The giant beast also knows this very well.
Poof...
The giant beast suddenly felt that the woman on its back was about to fall, and this time the magnitude was so great that it was impossible to right her up by shaking its back. In desperation, the giant beast turned around in the air while running wildly, directly hugged the woman into his arms, and then hit the ground hard with his back!
Boom!
The huge impact drew a deep ravine on the ground, and it took a long time before it finally stopped! After it stopped, the giant beast quickly spread its forelimbs and looked nervously at the woman in its arms.
The woman's face turned even paler, like a piece of paper soaked by rain. The woman weakly struggled out of the giant beast's arms. She didn't care about herself, but quickly lowered her head to look at the child in her arms.
The child seemed frightenedGenerally, the crying is even more intense, and the crying seems to be integrated with the lightning that keeps falling in the sky. The woman looked down and saw that the child was still alive, her lower lip tightened slightly, and tears fell down.
When the giant beast saw that both the woman and the child were fine, it actually showed an expression of relief on its face. Following the giant beast, it actually stood aside, and suddenly there was a mist around it. When the fog dissipated, it turned into a tall red-haired woman!
"Xiaoting, how do you feel?" The red-haired woman quickly squatted down and looked at the woman and asked anxiously.
The woman looked up at the red-haired woman, forced a pale smile, and said weakly, "I'm okay, I'm fine."
The woman's voice is like water, like song, like an orchid in an empty valley. Even though she is so downcast, her temperament remains unchanged, making the so-called ladies in the world feel ashamed.
There were torrential rains, more and more thunder and lightning, and the stormy waves of the ancient river crashed on the cliffs, shaking the mountains with earthquakes.
Before the red-haired woman could say anything, the woman spoke again and said weakly, "Furujiang is ahead of us. I'm at the end of my rope, but you are different. You are so strong, you can definitely break through the encirclement as long as you don't take me and the child with you."
"What are you talking about?!" When the red-haired woman heard Xiaoting's words, she looked angry and said, "Am I so greedy for life and afraid of death in your heart? I must keep you alive today. If they want to kill you, they will step over my body first. I don't believe they dare to offend us, the Fire Lion Clan!"
"They dare not offend the Fire Lion Clan, but they dare to kill you." The woman murmured softly, coughed twice, and said extremely weakly, "There are too many of them, and you are weak. Once they have murderous intentions, who can testify for you if they really kill you? If you die because of me, then I will not feel at ease on the road to hell."
"Xiaoting!" Not only did the red-haired woman not listen, but she became even more angry and said loudly, "I told you, no one can die today! I will change back to my original shape immediately and continue on my way!"
"Red!" Seeing that the red-haired woman was about to return to her animal form, the woman couldn't bear it any longer and scolded, "Can you please wake up? Furukawa is in front of us, where can we escape?!"
The red-haired woman known as 'Red' was shaken and stood there blankly. A bolt of lightning fell behind him, making a desperate sound.
"Then what should I do? I can't just watch you die!" Hongyi's eyes turned red all of a sudden. He knelt beside the woman and choked with sobs, "We agreed at the beginning that I would take you to the Fire Lion Tribe..."
"Let's live in the next life." The woman smiled and said softly, "With a good sister like you in this life, I will die without regrets."
After Hong Yi heard this, she couldn't help but turn her head away and shed tears desperately.
